kpis.description_fr: Resultat attribuable aux actions ordinaires du segment Sempra California (SDG&E + SoCalGas), regule par la CPUC. Premier pilier de profitabilite Sempra. Recul FY25 lie a regulatory disallowances et inflation operationnelle.
kpis.description_en: Earnings attributable to common shares for Sempra California segment (SDG&E + SoCalGas), CPUC-regulated. Largest Sempra profit pillar. FY25 drop driven by regulatory disallowances and operating inflation.
kpis._specific_to: Sempra core California regulated utility segment

kpis.description_fr: Resultat segment Sempra Texas Utilities (participation Oncor + Sharyland). Croissance soutenue portee par demande electrique ERCOT et expansion rate base au Texas.
kpis.description_en: Sempra Texas Utilities segment earnings (Oncor stake + Sharyland). Sustained growth driven by ERCOT electric demand and Texas rate base expansion.

kpis.description_fr: Resultat segment Sempra Infrastructure (LNG Cameron / Port Arthur, ECA, pipelines Mexique). Perte FY25 lie a impairment et phasing projets LNG en construction. Volatilite haute vs utilities regulees.
kpis.description_en: Sempra Infrastructure segment earnings (Cameron / Port Arthur LNG, ECA, Mexico pipelines). FY25 loss driven by impairment and LNG construction phasing. High volatility vs regulated utilities.

kpis.description_fr: Plan capex cumule 2026-2030 toutes activites : Sempra California 23.5 Mds $, Sempra Texas 11.1 Mds $, Sempra Infrastructure 4.1 Mds $. Determine la trajectoire rate base + growth EPS futur.
kpis.description_en: Cumulative 2026-2030 capex plan all segments: Sempra California $23.5B, Sempra Texas $11.1B, Sempra Infrastructure $4.1B. Drives rate base growth and forward EPS trajectory.
kpis._specific_to: Sempra forward growth visibility (5-year capital roadmap)

kpis.description_fr: Capex consolide PP&E et investissements equity method : Sempra California 4543 M $, Sempra Texas, Sempra Infrastructure 6063 M $ FY25. Accelere par ECA LNG Phase 1 et Port Arthur LNG.
kpis.description_en: Consolidated PP&E and equity-method investment capex: Sempra California $4,543M, Sempra Texas, Sempra Infrastructure $6,063M FY25. Accelerated by ECA LNG Phase 1 and Port Arthur LNG.
kpis._specific_to: Sempra capital intensity / LNG build phase

kpis.description_fr: Population desservie par SDG&E (San Diego + Orange County partiel), service electrique. Indicateur stabilite de la franchise regulee californienne. Base de calcul des revenus regulatoires.
kpis.description_en: Population served by SDG&E (San Diego + part of Orange County), electric service. Indicator of California regulated franchise stability. Basis for regulated revenue calculations.

kpis.description_fr: Revenu consolide Sempra. Mix utilities regulees Californie/Texas + activites LNG/Infrastructure. Sensible aux prix gaz pass-through (cost of gas recovered in rates).
kpis.description_en: Sempra consolidated revenue. Mix of California/Texas regulated utilities + LNG/Infrastructure activities. Sensitive to pass-through gas costs (cost recovered in rates).
